purpose: Document first-party cadastral-source discovery and bounded anonymous access review for Mianwali, Pakistan.
assessment: The official Punjab PULSE urban land-system viewer's current JavaScript lists Mianwali as cadastral sublayer 21 of Punjab_Cdastral_Maps. The configured ArcGIS MapServer route is public in the viewer configuration, but direct anonymous service and layer metadata returned ArcGIS error 499 Token Required. No parcel geometry or native parcel identity was retained; runtime remains held.
